top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, mature chain of discovery: proglucagon processing and the active GLP-1 peptides (Mojsov), human incretin physiology (Holst), and mechanisms of action in gut, pancreas and brain (Drucker). The therapeutic consequence is independently confirmed in large randomized trials for glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The three-person allocation protects the discovery of what the hormone is and does, and the citation scope on physiology and active forms is accurate. No award is clearly inferior to a ripe, well-documented achievement of this magnitude.
